title: Fischer's 24-vertex zero-forcing counterexample
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of Mikko Fischer's explicit connected 24-vertex subcubic graph with independence number 9 and zero-forcing number 11. The formalization verifies the exact graph and both numerical invariants, yielding an existential counterexample to the proposed bound Z(G) <= alpha(G) + 1 for connected graphs of maximum degree at most 3.

formalizes.title: A counterexample to the zero forcing versus independence conjecture for cubic and subcubic graphs
